title: Win back the Pearls
description: Gorge's vassals carried off the Pearls of the Wellspring and hid them in their lairs. Win each one back and bring it home: every Pearl that sinks into the Wellspring wakes a little more of the world.

stages.title: Fatty's Pearl
stages.description: Fatty One Eye keeps the first Pearl close, deep in his lair behind the old Thorn Guard gate.

objectives.label: Find the Pearl in Fatty's Lair
Bring it home to the Wellspring

stages.title: The Matron's Pearl
stages.description: The Orb-Weaver Matron hides the second Pearl in the Weaver Hollow, high in the old Watch Oak.

objectives.label: Find the Pearl in the Weaver Hollow
Bring it home to the Wellspring

stages.title: The Colossus's Pearl
stages.description: Crystal has grown around the third Pearl, deep in the Crystal Mine, and something big guards it.

objectives.label: Find the Pearl in the Crystal Mine
Bring it home to the Wellspring

pearls.name: Fatty's Pearl
pearls.gift: The Heavy skin. Home, it wakes Market Hill.

pearls.name: The Matron's Pearl
pearls.gift: The Silk skin. Home, it wakes West Hill and raises Slimeshire's Workshop.

pearls.name: The Colossus's Pearl
pearls.gift: The Feral skin. Home, it wakes the south gate's quarter and lights Slimeshire's Forge.

title: Pip's Workshop
description: Pip, the smith's son, keeps his dad's Workshop while his dad works the crystal mine: a heap of boards and a cold Forge. Every Pearl that goes home to the Wellspring wakes a little more of the world.

stages.title: The Workshop
stages.description: The Workshop has caved in. Maybe the next Pearl to go home will raise it again.

objectives.label: Bring the Matron's Pearl home to raise the Workshop

stages.title: A bow rune
stages.description: With the Workshop standing, Pip can carve a bow rune: wood for its frame, a string strong as wire for its string, and a clear crystal for its heart.

objectives.label: Bring Pip 5 wood, the Matron's thread and a crystal from his dad's mine

stages.title: The Forge
stages.description: The Forge is still cold. Pip's dad says it only wakes for something really strong.

objectives.label: Bring the Colossus's Pearl home to light the Forge
